dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor connections, events, and redeems from every platform in one place.

interactionControl.title: Interactions
interactionControl.enabledDescription: Rules, tests, and modes can add interactions to the queue.
interactionControl.disabledDescription: Events are still recorded, but they do not create interactions or accumulate progress. Disabling clears everything pending.

tikfinity.error: The TikFinity companion could not start or connect.

events.title: Recent events

interactions.title: Interactions
interactions.description: Configure how gifts, taps, and follows affect the match and test their execution order.

notice.catalogError: The installed catalog could not be loaded.

list.title: Redeems
list.description: Configure the redeems that can appear while you play.
list.limitReached: The redeem limit has been reached.
list.emptyTitle: You don't have any redeems yet
list.emptyDescription: Create the first one to link a live event to an in-game action.

editor.description: Choose which live event triggers it and the interaction it should produce.
editor.emptyDescription: The editor will appear here without leaving the page.
editor.giftTriggerHint: Uses the received quantity of one specific gift.
editor.likeTriggerHint: Tracks the taps sent by each user separately during the session.
editor.followTriggerHint: Recognizes the first follow event from each user during the session.
editor.everyHint: 1 activates the redeem for each received unit.
editor.likeEveryHint: The remainder carries over to the next tap event from the same user.
editor.followOnceHint: Each user can trigger this interaction only once per session. Unfollowing and following again will not repeat it.
editor.quantityHint: Number of interactions that will enter the queue.
editor.enabledHint: It will accept events as soon as the connection is ready.

actions.label: Redeem actions
actions.deleteDescription: The redeem linked to “{name}” will be deleted.

feedback.catalog_unavailable: The mod could not validate the gift catalog.
feedback.save_failed: The redeem configuration could not be saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adjust active redeems and how the donor appears in the game.
settings.maxActiveHint: Number of items that can be active at the same time.
settings.showGiftImageHint: It will appear next to the donor name.

status.pending: They will apply when you return to the game.
status.error: The changes could not be saved.

queue.title: Redeems in progress
queue.description: Active redeems and those waiting their turn appear here, respecting the configured simultaneous limit.
queue.clearConfirmDescription: Anything already active will keep running.
queue.pausedDescription: The queue is paused. New interactions will keep arriving, but no pending interaction will start until you resume it.
queue.emptyDescription: When a test or stream rule creates a redeem, you can follow its execution here.

test.title: Tests
test.description: Add one or more redeems without changing the order of items already waiting.

suspended.title: Interactions paused
suspended.description: Pesky Mode is active. New redeems keep their place, but will not enter the game until you disable it.

random.title: Random test
random.description: Sends random catalog items and names at short, varying intervals, only while a match is active.

switch.title: Pesky Mode is active right now
switch.description: To use Random Test, I will disable Pesky Mode.

feedback.random_test_disabled_by_pesky: The random test was disabled because Pesky Mode was enabled.
feedback.random_test_enabled: The random test is active and will wait for a match to be in progress.
feedback.phase_transition_protection_disabled: Transition protection is inactive for this session.

feedback.queued: The redeems were added to the queue.
feedback.queued_paused: The interactions were saved in the queue and will wait until playback is available again.
feedback.interactions_disabled: Interactions are disabled and everything pending was cleared.
feedback.pending_empty: There were no pending interactions to clear.
feedback.queue_full: The queue reached its temporary limit.
feedback.sent: The item was sent into the fight.
feedback.spawn_failed: The item could not be created. Check the fight state.

pesky.title: Pesky Mode
pesky.description: Adds random attacks from the interaction catalog during any fight, whether entered normally or through the roulette. You can also configure names to appear randomly with the attacks.

switch.title: Random Test is active right now
switch.description: To use Pesky Mode, I will disable Random Test.

phaseProtection.title: Transition protection
phaseProtection.description: For the Devil, blocking starts 6 seconds after the phase 1 to 2 signal. For a full comparison, change it before the transformation; it turns back on when the game restarts.

queue.title: Mode queue
queue.description: Attacks appear up to the configured simultaneous limit. The rest wait in the order they were generated.
queue.emptyDescription: Enable Pesky Mode and enter a gameplay level to see generated attacks here.
queue.name: Name

names.title: Random names
names.description: Enter one name per line. Blank lines and duplicates are removed; each name may contain up to 32 characters.
names.hint: One name is selected randomly for each attack.
names.required: You need at least one name to enable the mode.

attacks.title: Available attacks
attacks.description: Check the items that may appear. New catalog items will be enabled automatically.
attacks.required: Enable at least one attack before starting the mode.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.description: Review the available challenges and configure a specific result for the roulette.

challenges.description: Select a challenge to include or remove it from the roulette. At least one must remain active in each category.
challenges.required: At least one challenge must remain active in this category

force.title: Force roulette
force.description: Choose the roulette result to record intros or prepare a specific combination.
